snippet.title: KeyCapy - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist KeyCapy on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5427070/KeyCapy/
https://keycapy.com/

Run a small custom keyboard business in this cozy sim game. Assemble new boards, design your own, or clean and repair old ones for your capybara customers. Every component you choose changes the sound, so find your perfect combination and enjoy the satisfying, tactile process of building keyboards.
